scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:apps
scripts.deploy:frontend: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.deploy:backend: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter backend deploy ./deploy/backend --prod
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm run build:apps && pnpm --filter backend deploy ./deploy/backend --prod
scripts.serve:frontend:prod: pnpm run deploy:frontend && pnpm --filter frontend preview
